entities.summary: Wilm Weppelmann was a German artist, conceptual artist, garden artist, photographer and writer based in Münster Germany, with extensive solo exhibitions concerning the boundaries of human existence. Since 2005, Weppelmann has focused primarily on the meaning of garden culture and its role in the development of human existence.
